ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - RURAT Execution From Unusual Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of Remote Utilities RAT (RURAT) from an unusual location (outside of 'C:\Program Files')

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rutserv\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rfusclient\\\.exe$")) OR process_product = "Remote\ Utilities") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Remote\\ Utilities") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Remote\\ Utilities")))
